notes.title: Jumpy 12.1 (Iroh Direct P2P networking!)
notes.content:
[h1]Important notes regarding online play:[/h1]
- To connect to online, mathchmaker server should now be set to `lokmcpce2uzezmh2iq3vf23cbu3grzrct66qcpdfrizmcrrlk5uq`. Check settings, and [b]press Reset on Networking tab[/b] to fix if not correct.

[h2]Known Issues:[/h2]
- In online play, players may get hung on black screen during round transitions rarely. 
- A crash on connecting to online match has been observed but working on reproduction. If your game crashes in this situation (or any) please mention in discord or github - It may help us track it down. Thanks!

[h2]The cool stuff (Networking / Iroh):[/h2]
Previously in online matches all players connecting to matchmaking server and relayed requests through it. This led to very high latency depending on player locations. We now use [url=https://iroh.computer/]Iroh[/url]'s awesome tech to connect players directly P2P (lower latency). In the case that a player cannot be directly connected to, a relay is used for only that player. Everyone should be connectable, but possibly HUGE improvements to latency for players who were previously not close to our server. 

[b]Please give online a try with friends, nearby or across the globe, and let us know what the network experience is like. Thanks![/b]

[h2]Checkout what else is new at change log:[/h2]
https://github.com/fishfolk/jumpy/releases
